target.statement: NDCG@100 of the best BPR configuration on ML-20M (0.4012, from Table 5, SGD + adaptive negative sampling)

compute.basis: Training a BPR model with 1024-dim embeddings on ML-20M (9.7M interactions) for 1000 epochs plus hyperparameter search; the paper's code is available but may require adaptation, and the exact hyperparameters for the target cell are not fully specified in the text.

blockers: Exact hyperparameters (learning rate, regularization values) for the target cell are not given in the paper; they are only in the GitHub repo, which may be incomplete or outdated.
The paper's code is a research prototype; reproducing the exact number may require debugging and re-implementation of some parts.
title: Revisiting BPR: A Replicability Study of a Common Recommender System Baseline
